entries.name: Eesti Maaülikool Väikeloomakliinik (Small Animal Clinic, Estonian University of Life Sciences)
entries.duty: Emergency care 24/7. Phone 09:00-20:00 +372 731 3224, night 20:00-09:00 +372 503 3878 (on-duty vet). Call before coming; critical patients are seen first and you may be referred elsewhere if the clinic is full.
entries.note: Emergency-care page confirms 24/7 and both phones and address.

entries.name: PetCity Loomakliinik Rannamõisa (PetCity lemmikute kiirabi)
entries.duty: Pet emergency service (PetCity lemmikute kiirabi) at the Rannamõisa clinic provides round-the-clock help, short number 15222. Regular clinic hours Mon-Sat 10:00-20:00, Sun 10:00-18:00.
entries.note: Astri page states verbatim: 'PetCity Rannamõisa loomakliinikus töötab ka ööpäevaringset abi pakkuv PetCity lemmikute kiirabi, mille lühinumber on 15222.' Address from balticguide.ee/en/petcity; Astri page gives no address. Own site petcity.ee not fetchable.

entries.name: Loomade Kiirabikliinik (Evidensia)
entries.duty: Animal emergency clinic; call ahead. Out-of-hours visits carry a surcharge.
entries.note: Verified on German embassy list (name, address, phone 502 3191): labelled Notdienst, no hours, so emergency_24h false. Own site loomakiirabi.ee not fetchable; ERR article says it takes night/weekend patients, not stated as 24h.

entries.name: Västriku Loomakliinik
entries.note: Verified on German embassy list (name, address, phone 655 3366); no hours. Clinic site not fetchable. Named in ERR article as Evidensia clinic.

entries.name: Tierklinik Dr. Tiia Toomet (Toometi kliinik)
entries.note: Verified on German embassy list (name, address, phone 641 3110); no hours. Clinic site not fetchable.

notes: Estonia run 2026-11-05 was heavily limited: WebFetch only accepted URLs that appeared in search results or earlier fetches, and web search returned few clinic sites. Not reachable/not found: Veterinaar- ja Toiduamet (no duty list or poison line found), Eesti Loomaarstide Koda/Ühing, clinics' own sites (petcity.ee, evidensia.ee, loomakiirabi.ee, vastriku.ee, toometikliinik.ee). No animal poison information line found for Estonia (the university clinic treats poisoning as an emergency, 24/7). No duty rota page found. Names without contact data (not added): Anivet Veterinary Hospital, Väike-Sõjamäe Animal Clinic (Tallinn), Tartu Loomakliinik OÜ, Pärnu väikeloomakliinik, Evidensia clinics Billy/Fahle/Timmu/Viimsi/Rakvere. Left: other 24-h clinics (Tallinn, Pärnu, Narva, Saaremaa, Haapsalu, Viljandi), tourist-area clinics (Saaremaa, Lahemaa, Otepää, Hiiumaa), a rerun is needed with direct clinic site access.
